slides.headline: See AI's Hidden Instructions
slides.say: I found a GitHub project that lets you see the hidden instructions that shape AI answers. This is Day 3 of our exclusive 100-day series, finding the best GitHub repo for you.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.body: Collects leaked system prompts from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Cursor and more
slides.say: This repo gathers the secret system prompts that tell major AI products how to behave — the hidden rules behind every answer you get.

slides.headline: What's inside
slides.body: Full extracted prompts and guidelines showing how AI labs shape model behavior with unseen prompt scaffolds
slides.say: You get the actual prompt scaffolds — the massive instruction sets that force personas, decide refusals, and bake in ethical frames before you even ask a question.

slides.headline: 50,985 GitHub stars
slides.say: It has over 50 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the AGPL-3.0 licence. It's been around since March 2025.

slides.headline: Before you use it
slides.body: Prompts are leaked or reverse-engineered, not official; read the licence first
slides.say: These prompts are leaked or reverse-engineered, not released by the companies. Read the licence and README before relying on them.

slides.headline: Save · Share · Follow
slides.say: Loved it? Save this, and send it to a friend. Follow for the next 97 repos... or you might not see us again. The full list, with install commands and similar repos, is in my bio.
